parentNote.en: Every question is answered in the app. Each goal has a short home activity: say the words aloud together, and let your child guess first.
parentNote.ar: كل الأسئلة الطفل بيحلها جوه البرنامج، ولكل هدف نشاط قصير في البيت. قولوا الكلمات بصوت عالي مع بعض، وسيبوا طفلك يتوقع الأول.

steps.title: Story time: Aqsa's Adventures
steps.prompt: Tap each part of the story to listen.

options.label: Beginning. Aqsa finds a purple, furry monster called Blipblop. He is wearing her Mum's yellow coat, a red hat and black socks.

Middle. Aqsa slips into the washing machine and falls into Blipblopia, a land of ice-cream mountains and a lemonade river. She chases a little plopper cropper. Then the big mother plopper cropper chases her!
End. A soft green cloud saves her. She falls asleep on it, and wakes up in her own bed. Was it a dream?

steps.explanation: A fantasy story could not really happen. It has a beginning, middle and end.
steps.shortExplanation: A fantasy story could not really happen. It has a beginning, middle and end.

englishVisual.title: Aqsa's Adventures
englishVisual.text: A story with a beginning, a middle and an end.

steps.title: Sentences

options.label: A sentence starts with a capital letter, like the engine at the front of a train.
A sentence ends with a full stop, the last carriage that says stop.
Names, and the word I, start with a capital letter too.

steps.explanation: Every sentence starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop.
steps.shortExplanation: Every sentence starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop.

englishVisual.text: The cat sat on the mat.

steps.title: Missing sounds
steps.prompt: It grows in the garden. Write the missing sounds.
steps.hint: Say tree slowly: t-r-ee. Two letters make the last sound.
steps.explanation: Tree ends with the ee sound, written with two letters: e and e.
steps.shortExplanation: Tree ends with the ee sound, written with two letters: e and e.

steps.title: Missing sounds
steps.prompt: You wear it when it is cold. Write the missing sounds.
steps.hint: Say coat slowly: c-oa-t. The middle sound has two letters.
steps.explanation: Coat is c, oa, t. The oa sound is written with two letters.
steps.shortExplanation: Coat is c, oa, t. The oa sound is written with two letters.

steps.title: The oa sound
steps.prompt: Tap all the words with the oa sound, like in boat.
steps.hint: Tap a word to hear it. Listen for oa in the middle.
steps.explanation: Boat, goat, road and loaf all have the oa sound in the middle.
steps.shortExplanation: Boat, goat, road and loaf all have the oa sound in the middle.

steps.title: Real or fantasy?
steps.prompt: Could it really happen? Put each sentence in Real or Fantasy.

options.label: A boy plays football in the park.
A purple monster lives in the washing machine.
There are mountains made of ice cream.
Mum puts the clothes in the washing machine.

steps.hint: Ask: could this happen in our home or our street?
steps.explanation: A boy and Mum can really do these things. Monsters and ice-cream mountains are fantasy.
steps.shortExplanation: A boy and Mum can really do these things. Monsters and ice-cream mountains are fantasy.

source.answerKeyText: a R • b F • c F • d R

steps.title: Capital letter and full stop
steps.prompt: Which sentence is written the right way?

options.label: the cat sat on the mat.
The cat sat on the mat
The cat sat on the mat.

steps.hint: Look at the first letter and at the very end.
steps.explanation: It starts with a capital T and ends with a full stop.
steps.shortExplanation: It starts with a capital T and ends with a full stop.

source.answerKeyText: The cat sat on the mat.

steps.title: Make a sentence
steps.prompt: Tap the words in order to make a sentence.
steps.hint: Who is the sentence about? Start with her name.
steps.explanation: Aqsa jumped onto the cloud. It starts with a name and ends with a full stop.
steps.shortExplanation: Aqsa jumped onto the cloud. It starts with a name and ends with a full stop.

steps.title: Beginning, middle or end?
steps.prompt: Where does each part of Aqsa's story go?

options.label: Aqsa wakes up in her own bed.
Aqsa falls into the washing machine.
The mother plopper cropper chases Aqsa.

steps.hint: What happens first, and how does the story finish?
steps.explanation: Aqsa falls in at the beginning, is chased in the middle, wakes at the end.
steps.shortExplanation: Aqsa falls in at the beginning, is chased in the middle, wakes at the end.

source.answerKeyText: a end • b beginning • c middle

steps.title: Add s or es
steps.prompt: More than one: does each word add s or es?
steps.hint: Say two of each and clap: box-es has an extra clap.
steps.explanation: Words ending in s, x, sh or ch add es: boxes, dishes, buses.
steps.shortExplanation: Words ending in s, x, sh or ch add es: boxes, dishes, buses.

source.answerKeyText: add s: cats, dogs, birds • add es: boxes, dishes, buses

steps.title: My fantasy creature
steps.prompt: Which sentence is about a fantasy creature, and written the right way?

options.label: My dragon can fly to the Moon.
my dragon can fly to the Moon.

steps.hint: It must be something that could not be real, with a capital letter and a full stop.
steps.explanation: A dragon on the Moon is fantasy, with a capital and a full stop.
steps.shortExplanation: A dragon on the Moon is fantasy, with a capital and a full stop.

source.answerKeyText: Any creature that could not be real, with a name. The sentence must start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.

steps.title: What is a fantasy story?
steps.prompt: A fantasy story is about things that…

options.label: could not happen in real life

steps.hint: Think of a monster in the washing machine.
steps.explanation: A fantasy story is about things that could not happen in real life.
steps.shortExplanation: A fantasy story is about things that could not happen in real life.

source.answerKeyText: could not happen in real life

steps.title: Where did Aqsa fall?
steps.hint: She looked inside the place where clothes are washed.
steps.explanation: Aqsa slipped into the washing machine and fell into Blipblopia.
steps.shortExplanation: Aqsa slipped into the washing machine and fell into Blipblopia.

steps.title: The end of a sentence
steps.hint: It is the last carriage of the train. It says stop.
steps.explanation: A sentence ends with a full stop.
steps.shortExplanation: A sentence ends with a full stop.

steps.title: More than one fox
steps.hint: Fox ends with x. Clap fox-es.
steps.explanation: Fox ends with x, so more than one is foxes.
steps.shortExplanation: Fox ends with x, so more than one is foxes.

steps.title: The main character
steps.prompt: Who is the main character in Aqsa's Adventures?
steps.hint: The story is mostly about this person.
steps.explanation: The story is mostly about Aqsa, so she is the main character.
steps.shortExplanation: The story is mostly about Aqsa, so she is the main character.

stickers.meaning: A story about things that could not happen in real life.

goalActivities.text: Say a word slowly and tap the table once for each sound: h-a-t, s-o-ck, c-oa-t, t-r-ee. Then your child writes it, one sound for each tap.
goalActivities.textAr: قول كلمة ببطء واخبط على الترابيزة مرة مع كل صوت: h-a-t و s-o-ck و c-oa-t و t-r-ee. وبعدين طفلك يكتبها، صوت مع كل خبطة.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Find oa words together: boat, goat, road, toad, loaf. Write each one and colour the o and a in the same colour.
goalActivities.textAr: دوّروا على كلمات فيها oa مع بعض: boat و goat و road و toad و loaf. اكتبوا كل كلمة ولوّنوا الـ o والـ a بنفس اللون.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Play spoon and fork: you say a sentence. If it could really happen your child lifts the spoon; if it could never happen, the fork.
goalActivities.textAr: العبوا لعبة المعلقة والشوكة: تقول جملة، لو ممكن تحصل بجد طفلك يرفع المعلقة، ولو مستحيل تحصل يرفع الشوكة.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Write a short sentence with no capital and no full stop. Your child is the teacher and fixes it with a coloured pencil.
goalActivities.textAr: اكتب جملة قصيرة من غير حرف كبير ولا نقطة، وطفلك يبقى المدرّس ويصلّحها بقلم ملوّن.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Write the words of a short sentence on little papers and mix them up. Your child puts them in order and reads the sentence.
goalActivities.textAr: اكتبوا كلمات جملة قصيرة على ورق صغير ولخبطوها، وطفلك يرتبها ويقرا الجملة.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Retell a story your child knows, pointing to your head for the beginning, your tummy for the middle and your feet for the end.
goalActivities.textAr: احكوا قصة طفلك عارفها، وشاوروا على الراس للبداية، والبطن للنص، والرجلين للنهاية.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Put out one spoon, then two: two spoons. One box, then two: two boxes. Clap each word and listen for the extra part.
goalActivities.textAr: حط معلقة وبعدين اتنين: two spoons. علبة وبعدين اتنين: two boxes. صقفوا مع كل كلمة واسمعوا الجزء الزيادة.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.

goalActivities.text: Your child draws a fantasy creature and gives it a name. Write one sentence about it together, with a capital letter and a full stop.
goalActivities.textAr: طفلك يرسم كائن خيالي ويسمّيه، واكتبوا جملة واحدة عنه مع بعض، بحرف كبير في الأول ونقطة في الآخر.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.

goalActivities.text: Look at a picture book together and find one thing that could happen and one thing that could not.
goalActivities.textAr: بصّوا على كتاب صور مع بعض، ولاقوا حاجة ممكن تحصل وحاجة مستحيل تحصل.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Retell Aqsa's story while you load the washing machine together. Ask: what did she find inside?
goalActivities.textAr: احكوا قصة أقصى وانتو بتحطوا الهدوم في الغسالة مع بعض، واسألوا: لقت إيه جوه؟
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Read a page of a book together. Your child taps each full stop and you both take a little breath.
goalActivities.textAr: اقروا صفحة من كتاب مع بعض، وطفلك يخبط على كل نقطة وانتو الاتنين تاخدوا نفس صغير.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Say "two" before words that end in s, x, sh or ch: two boxes, two dishes, two foxes. Clap the extra part.
goalActivities.textAr: قولوا "two" قبل كلمات آخرها s أو x أو sh أو ch: two boxes و two dishes و two foxes. وصقفوا للجزء الزيادة.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: After a story or a cartoon, ask: who was it mostly about? That is the main character.
goalActivities.textAr: بعد قصة أو كارتون اسألوا: كانت أغلبها عن مين؟ ده البطل.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

homeActivities.text: Read a bedtime story together. Stop at the end of each part and ask: is this the beginning, the middle or the end? Could it really happen?
homeActivities.textAr: اقروا قصة قبل النوم مع بعض. وقّفوا في آخر كل جزء واسألوا: ده أولها ولا نصّها ولا آخرها؟ ينفع تحصل بجد؟
